exercises.explanationUz:
ESLATISh va TINChLANTIRISh.

  ESLATISh:
    Make sure you ... = albatta ...
    Don't forget to ... = ... ni
    unutma
  TINChLANTIRISh (va'da):
    'Make sure you go' → 'I WILL'
    'Don't forget' → 'I WON'T'
    (forget)

  ⚠ Javob eslatma shakliga mos:
  tasdiq buyruq → I will
  inkor buyruq (Don't) → I won't


⚠ 'MAKE SURE':

  = ishonch hosil qil, albatta
  ... qil.


⚠ 'ON YOUR WAY HOME':

  = uyga qaytishda.

exercises.instructionEn: SPEND THE SUMMER IN AMERICA. Do you enjoy working with kids? We're looking for active and creative young men and women to work at our lovely summer camp by Lake Tonawonda. Please write to us if you are interested in enjoying a summer full of sports and theatre in the United States. Contact: Mrs Lynn Davis, Lake Tonawonda Summer Camp, Syracuse, New York 10025 USA.
exercises.instructionUz: YOZNI AMERIKADA O'TKAZING. Bolalar bilan ishlashni yoqtirasizmi? Biz Tonawonda ko'li bo'yidagi go'zal yozgi lagerimizda ishlash uchun faol va ijodkor yosh yigit-qizlarni izlayapmiz. Agar Qo'shma Shtatlarda sport va teatrga to'la yozdan bahra olishni xohlasangiz, bizga yozing. Bog'lanish: Xonim Lin Devis, Tonawonda ko'li yozgi lageri, Sirakyus, Nyu-York 10025 AQSh.

E'LON - YOZGI LAGERDA ISh.
  (coursebook 37-bet 21-mashq
  kabi)

  (qo'lyozma qaydlar):

  'work' → how many hours a day?
    meals & accommodation?
  'summer' → which months?

  ⚠ Shu savollar XATDA so'raladi

exercises.explanationUz:
RASMIY XAT - MA'LUMOT SO'RASh.

TUZILISh:
  O'NGDA: yozuvchi manzili + sana
  ChAPDA: oluvchi manzili
  Dear Mrs Davis, (ism MA'LUM)
  Para 1 - yozish sababi
  Para 2 - savollar
  Para 3 - yakuniy so'zlar
  Yours sincerely, (ism ma'lum
  bo'lgani uchun!) + to'liq ism


⚠ IKKI MANZIL:

  Rasmiy xatda IKKALA manzil:
  yozuvchiniki (o'ngda) va
  oluvchiniki (chapda).


⚠ RASMIY IBORALAR:

  'I am writing regarding ...' =
    ... yuzasidan yozyapman
  'I would be grateful if you
    could ...' = ... sangiz
    minnatdor bo'lardim
  'further information' =
    qo'shimcha ma'lumot
  'First of all, ... In addition
    to this, ... Finally, ...' -
    savollar tartibi
  'Thank you for your assistance'
    = yordamingiz uchun rahmat
  'I look forward to hearing from
    you' = javobingizni intiqlik
    bilan kutaman


⚠ 'EDITION':

  = nashr (jurnal soni). 'the
  April edition' = aprel soni.


⚠ 'TO HIRE':

  = ishga olmoq.


⚠ 'STAFF ARE REQUIRED TO WORK':

  = xodimlar ishlashi talab
  qilinadi.


⚠ 'TO PROVIDE':

  = ta'minlamoq, bermoq.


⚠ 'LOOK FORWARD TO + V-ING':

  'hearing' (V-ing!), 'hear' EMAS.

sections.title: Writing (a formal letter asking for information)

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the advertisement in the May edition of 'Summer Work', then use the question points to write a letter asking for information (100 - 150 words). Use the letter in Ex. 17 as a model. Advertisement: Collingbury Farm is looking for fruit pickers for this summer. The right people for the job will: be able to work 40 hours/week; stay on the farm for the fruit-picking season; be young and fit; have previous experience. For further information contact: Martin Ellis, Collingbury Farm, NN4 9YL Tramford. Question points: have to work weekends? pick fruit using machines/by hand? own room/have to share with sb? work on uncle's farm during school holidays - satisfactory experience?
exercises.instructionUz: 'Summer Work' jurnalining may sonidagi e'longa qarang, so'ng savol qaydlari bilan ma'lumot so'rab xat yozing (100-150 so'z). 17-mashqdagi xatdan namuna sifatida foydalaning. E'lon: Collingbury fermasi shu yoz uchun meva teruvchilarni izlayapti. Ish uchun mos odamlar: haftasiga 40 soat ishlay oladi; meva terish mavsumida fermada turadi; yosh va baquvvat; oldingi tajribasi bor. Qo'shimcha ma'lumot uchun: Martin Ellis, Collingbury Farm, NN4 9YL Tramford. Savol qaydlari: dam olish kunlari ishlash kerakmi? mevani mashina bilan/qo'lda terishmi? o'z xona/birov bilan bo'lishishmi? maktab ta'tilida amakining fermasida ishlash - yetarli tajribami?
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMIY SO'ROV XATI - FERMADA ISh.

REJA (17-mashq):
  O'ngda: o'z manzil + sana
  Chapda: Martin Ellis, Collingbury
    Farm, NN4 9YL Tramford
  Dear Mr Ellis, (ism MA'LUM)
  Para 1 - yozish sababi ('Summer
    Work', May edition)
  Para 2 - savollar (4 qayd):
    '40 hours/week' → dam olish
      kunlari? mashina/qo'lda?
    'stay on the farm' → o'z xona/
      bo'lishish?
    'previous experience' → amaki
      fermasi yetarlimi?
  Para 3 - yakuniy so'zlar
  Yours sincerely, + to'liq ism


⚠ 'A FRUIT PICKER':

  = meva teruvchi. 'to pick' =
  termoq.


⚠ 'FIT':

  = baquvvat, sog'lom.


⚠ 'PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE':

  = oldingi tajriba.


⚠ 'TO SHARE WITH SB':

  = birov bilan bo'lishmoq (xona).


⚠ 'SATISFACTORY':

  = qoniqarli, yetarli.


⚠ 100-150 SO'Z.

Martin Ellis

Dear Mr Ellis,

I am writing regarding your advertisement in the May edition of 'Summer Work'. I would be grateful if you could send me some further information as I am interested in working as a fruit picker at Collingbury Farm this summer.

First of all, your advertisement states that fruit pickers work 40 hours a week. Do they have to work at weekends? I would also like to know if we pick the fruit using machines or by hand. In addition to this, you say that workers stay on the farm. Do they have their own room, or do they have to share with somebody? Finally, I worked on my uncle's farm during the school holidays. Is this satisfactory experience for the job?

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Yours sincerely,
David Green
